claims: Petrache provides a 25-year historical and experimental synthesis of nuclear chirality across A~80, 100, 130, and 190, detailing the progression from single doublets to multiple chiral doublets (MchiD) and outlining the crucial role of next-generation tracking arrays (AGATA, GRETA).

The ongoing debate regarding transverse vs longitudinal wobbling in normal-deformed nuclei (135Pr, 187Au, 133La) hinges upon multipole mixing ratio delta(E2/M1) and polarization measurements to distinguish collective E2 wobbling from single-particle M1 transitions.

SU(2) coherent states map the triaxial rotor Hamiltonian to canonical phase space equations on the sphere, where the Dyson boson mapping and Bargmann representation yield the non-Hermitian operator with exact real spectra.
Phase space stability analysis of the classical energy surface yields the algebraic separatrix equation (1-u)(1-v^2)(v^2-u^2)(v^2-u)=0 bounding distinct dynamical rotation phases.

The Generalized Coherent State Model (GCSM) decomposes the triaxial particle-core Hamiltonian into chiral-symmetric H_s and chiral-antisymmetric H_a components, allowing exact chiral parity projection.
